content:
kevin: Quick sync — RFC review tomorrow 3pm PT. Need to lock presenters + order. Trying to keep this to 1 hour.
kevin: Authors, please confirm you'll present or nominate a proxy. Reviewers, please claim which RFC you want to cover. 
kevin: Proposed run-of-show (super short):
```
3:00 - 3:05 quick updates + housekeeping
3:05 - 3:25 RFC: async-cache (author: @sara)
3:25 - 3:40 RFC: batching-routing (author: @jess)
3:40 - 3:55 RFC: rollout-fallback (author: @michael)
3:55 - 4:00 action items + followups
```
kevin: If people have strong preferences about swapping order, call it out here — otherwise I'll lock this by 5pm today. :calendar:

sara: I'm presenting async-cache but I'm on call early morning; will present remotely, fine with the first slot. Can someone paste the pre-read link?

jess: i'll take batching-routing. prefer 2nd slot. pre-read is in the rfc folder: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/batching-routing (just pushed a tiny update) :thumbsup:

michael: rollout-fallback looks like something I should handle but i've got a calendar conflict 3:30-3:45. If someone can switch with me for the last slot, I can move to earlier or present a recorded short walkthrough.

caroline: i can swap with you @michael — i don't mind the later slot. i'll cover rollout-fallback at 3:40.

michael: thanks @caroline — will drop my calendar block.

kevin: Awesome. @calendar-bot can you send a reminder to reviewers + attach the pre-reads 30m before meeting?

calendar-bot: Reminder set: will post meeting reminder and attach files from /docs/rfcs/pre-read today at 2:30 PT. :robot_face:

jess: tiny ask — can we timebox Q&A per RFC to 10 min max? we've been overrun last month.

kevin: Yes, sticking to 10 min each. If deep dives needed, we'll spin up follow-ups. I'll annotate the agenda with timeboxes and pin the doc.

sara: Pre-read checklist for authors (copying here so reviewers know expectations):
- TL;DR + decision asked (1-2 bullets)
- Design diagram or sequence showing the change
- Perf/cost implications (estimates)
- Backwards compat notes + rollout plan

kevin: Perfect. I'm locking order now: async-cache (sara), batching-routing (jess), rollout-fallback (caroline). If anyone else wants to swap, speak up by 5pm. Otherwise i'll update the invite and add the pre-read checklist to each RFC doc.

caroline: noted. I'll add a one-slide summary to rollout-fallback pre-read by EOD.

michael: pushing my notes to the RFC thread now in case folks want to skim.

kevin: Thanks team — see you tomorrow. :party_parrot:
